items.title: Innventure: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Innventure announced a strategic pivot focused on cost reduction and debt restructuring. The company cut parent staff by 62% (from 40 to 15 employees), suspended new development, and stopped funding its operating subsidiaries. Each subsidiary—including liquid-cooling business Accelsius, flexible-packaging developer AeroFlexx, and waste-conversion unit Refinity—must now secure external capital independently. Management hired RBC Capital Markets to evaluate all options including debt restructuring and potential asset monetization.

items.title: 2026 National Poppy Campaign launches with a donation “first” … and stunning mural: Don’t forget to Remember
items.summary: The Royal Canadian Legion launched its 2026 National Poppy Campaign with new tap-on-phone contactless donation technology supported by BMO. A 4x7 metre mural featuring handwritten messages from Canadians was unveiled at Union Station in Toronto, honoring WWI veteran Allan McLean Davidson. The campaign includes multiple donation methods through partners like RBC, Amazon Canada, Starbucks, and TD Bank, with proceeds supporting Canadian Veterans and their families.
